description: In crates/core/src/audit.rs, flush_buffer records a single SystemTime::now() for ALL events in the flush batch. Events that were queued seconds or minutes before the flush fire all share the same timestamp, making the audit log useless for forensic sequencing (e.g. correlating an auth event with an article ingest). Fix: add a 'occurred_at: SystemTime' field to AuditEvent (or a wrapper struct) at the point the event is created (in the handle/send path), carry it through the channel, and use that per-event time when inserting into the DB.
title: audit flush_buffer: all events in batch get flush time, not event time
